spec.kitLine: Persona: every 3 sec, all allies, heal
spec.assertion: Stripping every heal effect drops total buffApply count by >=10 vs control — the heal reaches allies and fires the on-recovery teammate (crown) on a ~3s cadence. Fails under: heal dropped as defensive (delta 0), single battle-start heal, or a >=15s interval.

buffApply stat atkPct value 65.37 on yukiko occurs >=3 times; the first has expiresFrame ~900 (15s off frame 0); every later one is preceded by a fullBurstEnd boundary, never fullBurstStart. Fails under: battle-start-only (count 1), fullBurstEnter keying (boundary is fullBurstStart), permanent encoding (expiresFrame not a 15s window).

Zero 1-More effects on the Fire-boss control comp; deleting bossElementGate makes damage-event count and yukiko total both rise. Fails under: line dropped entirely (gate-removal count 0, no new damage) or modeled ungated (fires vs a non-Wind boss).

Removing it lowers ONLY yukiko's total; teammate totals stay byte-identical, and no buffApply of that stat/value ever targets a non-yukiko index. Fails under: allies-scoped encoding, or the line missing (removal count 0).

spec.kitLine: Scarlet Flower on Burst Skill use
spec.assertion: Fire Amp distributedDamagePct 90.01 is applied >=2 times (once per own burst cast) with a bounded expiresFrame, self-only. Fails under a passive/continuous encoding (one apply at frame 0, whole-fight window) — the kit deactivates it at Full Burst end.

Stripping only the burst-triggered heal still lowers total buffApply count — the Scarlet Flower heal is a SECOND source stacked on the S1 Persona heal. Fails if both heal lines were folded into one block.

buffApply elemAdvantageDamagePct 48.15 occurs >=2 times and a burstCast still falls between the apply and the following fullBurstStart — i.e. it LEADS the stage-3 cast. Fails under burstCast / stageCast{3} keying, where the apply lands after the chain's last cast.
it.skip — defensive; the scope-lock boss deals no damage, so there is nothing observable.

Live assertion: no casterAtkPct flows from yukiko to another unit on the control comp (Wind-gated + no eligible ally). it.skip for the target set itself — no primitive for all-Burst-III-allies, and none at all for the Persona state; also note casterAtkPct emits FLAT-resolved ATK, so 80.25 is not matchable as a value.

Removing the flatDamage effect cuts yukiko's total by >2%; every burst-bucket damage event carries fbMajorApplied !== true (burst-cast damage lands before the Full Burst window). Fails under: line missing, or the nuke wrongly taking the +50% FB major.
No 45.33 buff on the Fire boss; with bossElementGate deleted it appears >=2 times as atkPct on yukiko. Fails under an ungated encoding (over-credits every fight) or the line being absent.

spec.kitLine: Fire Amp on the same-cast nuke
spec.assertion: it.skip — Scarlet Flower arms on the very cast that fires the distributed nuke, so whether the 90.01% amp reaches it is a cast-frame ordering question the kit does not settle. Recipe: popup-read her burst number with and without the amp.

fixtures: controlComp('yukiko', false) for every run — liter (B1) + crown (B2) + yukiko (B3). B1+B2 are mandatory or a lone Burst III never casts and the fight makes ZERO Full Bursts. The fixed second B3 (SR/Water) is deliberately dropped: with two B3s the stage-3 cast alternates, so yukiko's own-burst count (= how many Scarlet Flower windows exist) stops being deterministic and that unit's ally buffs contaminate every counterfactual delta. crown is retained on purpose — there is no heal/recovery event kind in the log, so yukiko's heals are observable ONLY through a teammate's on-recovery buffApply. 7 hoisted 180s runs: control, all-heals-off, scarlet-heal-off, boss-element-gates-off, S2 attack-damage-off, Fire-Amp-off, burst-nuke-off. Every counterfactual asserts its own removal count > 0, so a patch that removes nothing fails loudly instead of passing vacuously. Fixture limits: boss is Fire and yukiko is Fire, so (a) no elemental advantage — the S2 elem-adv buff is damage-inert and is verified structurally only, and (b) no Wind Code enemy — the entire 1 More cluster is verified by gate-inertness plus a gate-removed counterfactual.
gaps: S2 Follow Up target set — no engine target primitive for 'all standard Burst 3 allies' and none for 'in the Persona state'; also 1-More (Wind) gated, so it is doubly inert on this fixture. Live inertness assertion kept; target semantics skipped.

Heal magnitude (5.7% of the skill user's final Max HP, both Media and Mediarama) — the heal effect carries no HP amount and there is no HP pool at scope lock; only the recovery-event cadence is observable.
S2 Scarlet Protection (damage taken from Water Code enemies down 17.95%) — defensive, unobservable at scope lock (boss deals no damage).
Does Fire Amp (Distributed Damage 90.01%) amplify yukiko's OWN same-cast burst nuke — MEASUREMENT-GATED cast-frame ordering; asserting either direction blind would pin a guess.

Elemental-Advantage Attack Damage 48.15% damage-side effect — inert vs the Fire boss (Fire unit, Fire boss = no advantage) and the harness exposes no documented boss-element knob, so only the buffApply/trigger-identity side is asserted.

Scarlet Flower's 'Deactivation condition: when Full Burst ends' — the engine has no until-Full-Burst-end window primitive, so any durationSec is a flagged estimate; the test asserts the window is BOUNDED and re-armed per cast, not its exact length.
